en: Psalms 105

p.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

en: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
u.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

en: 105:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

en: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
u.src: 2  Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

p.src: 3  Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

en: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
u.src: 3  Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

p.src: 4  Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

en: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
u.src: 4  Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

p.src: 5  Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

en: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
u.src: 5  Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

p.src: 6  you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

en: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
u.src: 6  you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

p.src: 7  He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

en: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
u.src: 7  He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

p.src: 8  He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

en: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
u.src: 8  He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

p.src: 9  the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

en: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
u.src: 9  the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

p.src: 10  and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

en: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
u.src: 10  and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

p.src: 11  saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

en: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
u.src: 11  saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

p.src: 12  when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

en: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
u.src: 12  when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

p.src: 13  They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

en: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
u.src: 13  They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

p.src: 14  He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

en: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
u.src: 14  He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

p.src: 15  “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

en: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
u.src: 15  “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

p.src: 16  He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

en: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
u.src: 16  He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

p.src: 17  He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

en: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
u.src: 17  He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

p.src: 18  They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

en: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
u.src: 18  They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

p.src: 19  until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

en: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.
u.src: 19  until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

p.src: 20  The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

en: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
u.src: 20  The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

p.src: 21  He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
u.src: 21  He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

p.src: 22  to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

en: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
u.src: 22  to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

p.src: 23  Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

en: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
u.src: 23  Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

p.src: 24  He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

en: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
u.src: 24  He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

p.src: 25  He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
u.src: 25  He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

p.src: 26  He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

en: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
u.src: 26  He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

p.src: 27  They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

en: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
u.src: 27  They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

p.src: 28  He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

en: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
u.src: 28  He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

p.src: 29  He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

en: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
u.src: 29  He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

p.src: 30  Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

en: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
u.src: 30  Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

p.src: 31  He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

en: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
u.src: 31  He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

p.src: 32  He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

en: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
u.src: 32  He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

p.src: 33  He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

en: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
u.src: 33  He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

p.src: 34  He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

en: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
u.src: 34  He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

p.src: 35  They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

en: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
u.src: 35  They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

p.src: 36  He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

en: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
u.src: 36  He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

p.src: 37  He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

en: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
u.src: 37  He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

p.src: 38  Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

en: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
u.src: 38  Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

p.src: 39  He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

en: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
u.src: 39  He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

p.src: 40  They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

en: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
u.src: 40  They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

p.src: 41  He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
u.src: 41  He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

p.src: 42  For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

en: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
u.src: 42  For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

p.src: 43  He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

en: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
u.src: 43  He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

p.src: 44  He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

en: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
u.src: 44  He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

p.src: 45  that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

en: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 45  that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

en: 105:45 Hebrew: יה Yah
